wordCloud.howItWorks: Open a room and share its PIN or QR code, and everybody who joins adds a few words of their own — the cloud above grows live, and a word gets larger each time another person says it. popQuiz.howItWorks1: Write up to twenty questions, each with four choices or a blank to fill in, and play them through here to try it out. A right answer scores 500 points and up to 500 more for speed; a wrong one, a skipped one or none in time scores nothing.
popQuiz.howItWorks2: To play with a group, add Pop Quiz to a project and set it up from the project's dashboard. Everybody joins the room with its PIN or QR code and picks a nickname, you put the questions up one at a time, and the scoreboard follows. A quiz written here is not saved.

prompts: If this place had a voice, what would it say?
What is missing here that would bring joy or comfort?
Imagine this place in 2050 — what happens here?
What kind of stories could unfold in this place?
What would make you want to spend more time here?
If this place were a feeling, which one would you want it to be?
What would a perfect morning here look like?
Who do you wish you could meet here, and what would you do together?
What would a child love about this place if anything were possible?
What sounds would you like to hear when you arrive?
If you could give this place one gift, what would it be?
What memory would you like somebody to make here?
What would make this place feel like it belongs to everyone?
Imagine this place on its best day — what is going on?
What would you want to find here on a cold, dark evening?

dreamIt.whatForBody: Dream It unlocks imagination and makes a safe space for people to share personal visions, desires and emotional connections to a place. Rather than practical constraints or immediate solutions, it invites everybody to think freely about how the place could feel, function or inspire in the future.

steps.1: Choose the prompts: ours, your own, or both.
steps.2: Generate a prompt and read it aloud.
steps.3: Give people a quiet moment to imagine.
steps.4: Let each person speak, tell a story or speculate — and let the others listen.
steps.5: Generate another when the room is ready.

dreamIt.noWrongAnswers: There are no wrong answers and nothing to solve yet. Speaking, imagining and listening to each other is what builds a shared feeling for the place.

word-cloud.name: Word Cloud
word-cloud.tagline: Ask anything, and watch the answers live.
word-cloud.blurb: Ask a question to a group of people and let everybody answer in a few words of their own. Each word joins the cloud as it is added, and grows every time another person says it.

open-vote.name: Poll
open-vote.blurb: Ask a question to a group of people and let them vote. Just a question, answers, and a live tally as people pick.

budget-ballot.name: Co-Budget
budget-ballot.tagline: A fixed budget, more on the list than it buys. Choose.
budget-ballot.blurb: Every post has a price per item, and the money runs out well before the list does. Spend the budget the way you would, and see what the room would fund together.

pop-quiz.name: Pop Quiz
pop-quiz.tagline: Twenty questions, a clock, and a scoreboard.
pop-quiz.blurb: Write a quiz of up to twenty questions, each with four choices or a blank to fill in. Everybody joins with a nickname, the questions go up one at a time, and a right answer scores more the sooner it comes — a quick way to find out what a room already knows about a place.

dream-it.name: Dream It
dream-it.tagline: A prompt to set a room imagining, at the press of a button.
dream-it.blurb: An activity for unlocking imagination and making a safe space to share personal visions, desires and emotional connections to a place. Generate a prompt, and let people speak, imagine and listen to each other — about how the place could feel, function or inspire, rather than what is practical today.
